title: Scoped Interaction Identity Segments
description: Canonical scope:1: wire identity contains 1–32 ordered, nonempty UTF-8 strings. Each segment follows its positive decimal UTF-8 byte length and colon. Leading-zero lengths, truncated segments, invalid Unicode scalar sequences, trailing bytes and identities exceeding 65536 encoded UTF-8 bytes are refused. Segments retain their exact authored spelling and order.
